name: food-delivery-app
description: Full-stack Food Delivery Startup ops console — Express/MongoDB/JWT backend + React/Vite frontend, run and tested as one project.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
